question_1_pcr_capacity_reconciliation.enthalpy_definition: Reaction enthalpy of phosphocreatine hydrolysis and ATP resynthesis (Kodama 1985). Quantifies purely calorimetric heat exchange.
question_1_pcr_capacity_reconciliation.gibbs_definition: Thermodynamic Gibbs free energy of ATP hydrolysis under physiological intracellular conditions (Meyerspeer 2021). Quantifies maximum mechanical cross-bridge work potential.
question_1_pcr_capacity_reconciliation.harmonization_verdict: Formulas strictly segregated: P_mech = eta_loc * v_ATP * (-dG_ATP) uses 54.0 kJ/mol; Q_heat = v_ATP * (-dH_CK) uses 21.0 kJ/mol. Capacity in work units vs heat units explicitly distinct.

question_2_andersen_saltin_1985_audit.paper_muscle: Human quadriceps femoris (knee-extensor dynamic model, 8 males)
question_2_andersen_saltin_1985_audit.primary_resting_data_in_paper: Text on page 237 states femoral venous blood flow at rest in sitting position was 0.15 to 0.40 L/min. Table 1 lists subject mass/anthropometry. Table 2 tabulates exercise from 10 W to 60 W (NO resting row).
question_2_andersen_saltin_1985_audit.audit_verdict_2_4_ml_and_58_ml: The exact numbers 2.4 mL/100g/min and 58 mL/L do NOT exist as a tabulated resting baseline in Andersen & Saltin 1985. They originate from secondary textbook limb-level approximations (0.24 L/min / 10 kg limb = 2.4 mL/100g/min).

EXP-0037.title: Empirical Acquisition of Lower-Limb HD-sEMG Motor Unit Spike Trains and Dynamic 31P-MRS Bioenergetics

rehman_2024_31p_mrs.protocol: Dynamic knee extensions on non-magnetic ergometer at 1 Hz, 42 s exercise, 360 s recovery, 5-10% MVC

EXP-0038.title: Biophysical Measurement Model of Motor Unit Recruitment, Volume Conductor Filtering, and SAT Attenuation

fatigue_force_emg_dissociation.finding: During fatigue, sEMG RMS paradoxically increases (+14%) despite a 35% drop in mechanical force, demonstrating the total failure of scalar sEMG RMS as a monotonic proxy for metabolic activation.

core_findings: At 12.7% measured sEMG RMS, variation in subcutaneous fat thickness (3 to 10 mm) induces a 40.9-fold uncertainty span in true active muscle volume fraction a_eff (0.018 to 0.737).
During muscle fatigue, sEMG RMS paradoxically increases by +14.0% while mechanical twitch force drops by -35.0% due to conduction velocity slowing and intracellular action potential widening.
Single-channel sEMG RMS is structurally unidentifiable with respect to active muscle volume fraction without high-density multi-channel arrays and independent subcutaneous tissue morphometry.

EXP-0039.title: Real-Data Identifiability and Profile Likelihood of Local Energy Model with Recruitment Nuisance Parameters

level_4_empirical_identifiability.blocker: No human subject currently exists in open literature with simultaneous 31P-MRS, calibrated HD-sEMG motor unit decomposition, MRI adipose morphometry, and microvascular blood flow.
level_4_empirical_identifiability.minimal_sufficient_experimental_design: Simultaneous 3T 31P-MRS + 64-channel HD-sEMG + B-mode ultrasound fat thickness + arterial occlusion NIRS on single human subject during identical dynamic contraction protocol.

EXP-0040.title: Independent Cross-Subject Validation (LOSO) of Local Bioenergetic Model vs Physiological Baselines

cross_subject_loso_summary.epistemic_conclusion: Direct transfer of local recovery kinetics across independent human muscles degrades predictive RMSE by 120-160% compared to in-sample fits. Cross-muscle transfer without explicit fiber-type and mitochondrial scaling operators is empirically invalid.

EXP-0041.title: SUBJECT-01 Integration: Functional Power, Recovery Limits, and TARGET-CPE45 Boundaries
EXP-0041.scaling_operator_verdict: Local calf and quadriceps kinetic models cannot be scaled to 2700-second whole-body CPE45 without an independent cardiac output, pulmonary ventilation, and multi-muscle activation operator.
